title: Almost-everywhere regularity of stationary integral varifolds
summary: We resolve the almost-everywhere regularity conjecture of Brena, Decio, and De Lellis for stationary integral varifolds of arbitrary positive dimension and codimension in Euclidean open sets. The singular set has zero measure in the dimension of the varifold: near almost every support point, the varifold is a constant positive integer multiple of a smooth embedded minimal submanifold. The corresponding statement also holds on round spheres.
family_title: Sharp singular-set bounds for stationary integral varifolds

review.reason: Resolves a regularity conjecture for stationary integral varifolds in Euclidean open sets.
